Jo dard se darta hai, woh darr mein hi aadha dard sah leta hai.
Jo control mein hai usi pe focus karna.
Grit ke liye ekagrata chahiye.
Bas tab bol jab tumhare shabd chup rehne se behtar ho.
Raste mein aane wali rukavat hi raasta ban jati hai.
Himmat impossible ko doable banati.
Himmat greatness ki chingari hai.
Kriya darr ko theek karti.
Khamoshi ek bahut badi taakat ka zariya hai.
Grit buniyad hai.
Grit dil ki lagan aur jidd hai.
Hum tab uthte hain jab dusron ko lift karte hain.
Grit jang jeetati hai.
Chalo raat me kadam rakhein aur jo humein pasand hai uska peecha karein.
Himmat bhavishya banati hai.
Khamoshi mein hi taqat ki jad hai.
Himmat kuch nahi maangti.
Sahasik vyakti wo hai jo apne aap ka samna kar sakta hai.
Ye hamesha impossible lagta hai, jab tak ho na jaye.
Courage contagious—jab brave act karta, baaki follow karte.
